data.holdout: 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30 — not loaded, not inspected, not summarised until the verdict is written

decision_rule.note: Fixed before any result was computed. Not adjustable.

derived.note: Detection limit: the smallest TRUE annualised Sharpe this design could find with 80% power at alpha=0.05. A null result from this sweep says nothing about edges smaller than this.

hypothesis: Price-based short-horizon mean reversion produces no risk-adjusted edge after realistic costs, once selection across the full parameter space is accounted for.

protocol.execution_model: next-bar open, no partial fills, position capped at 1x notional
protocol.method: walk-forward, 12-month train / 3-month test, rolling, no refitting inside a test window
protocol.survivorship_note: symbols fixed at the start of the period, no delisting selection

search_space.enumeration_note: 3 families x 6 lookbacks x 5 thresholds x 3 exits x 3 caps x 3 symbols = 2430 fully enumerated variants. No variant is excluded after the fact.

family_descriptions.bollinger_touch: intrabar high/low touch of Bollinger band, fade
family_descriptions.zscore_reversion: z-score of close vs rolling mean, fade extremes

title: Short-horizon mean reversion on liquid crypto perpetuals
